en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small European town. A narrow river or canal runs through the foreground, lined by trees and a path on the left. On the right are multi‑story houses and industrial-looking buildings with simple facades and gabled roofs, plus a tall chimney in the distance. A bridge crosses the waterway toward the center-right. In the upper right corner, red printed text identifies the scene.
